children: Moog reported fiscal 2026 sales of $4.5B, up 17% from fiscal 2025, and free cash flow of $307M, up $179M. Adjusted segment operating margin rose 120 basis points to 14.2%; the company said it expects record sales and stronger operating performance in fiscal 2027.
FY26 sales $4.5B, up 17% year over year
Broad-based segment growth supports the record year and provides a strong starting point for fiscal 2027.
Expansion indicates improved underlying profitability; reported adjusted margins exclude net charges of $17M versus $52M in FY25.
Free cash flow $307M, up $179M year over year
Higher earnings and improved working capital efficiency drove a substantial cash-flow increase.
FY27 outlook: record sales, stronger operating performance
Management expects growth to continue, but the release provides no quantified FY27 targets.
FY26 tax benefits included $35M for prior-year research credits
This benefit relates to prior years; adjusted net earnings and EPS exclude it.

This is a late confirmation of a broad-based growth and margin-expansion trend, with record fiscal 2026 results across key measures. More specific fiscal 2027 sales, margin, earnings and cash-flow targets or subsequent quarterly results would clarify the outlook.
